title: Implement from a written spec
prompt: Implement slugify in slug.py exactly as described in README.md. Then run `sh test.sh` and make it pass.

files.README.md:
# slug

`slugify(text)` returns a URL slug:
- lowercase
- letters and digits kept, every other run of characters becomes a single `-`
- no leading or trailing `-`
- empty input returns `n-a`
files.test.sh:
python3 -c "
from slug import slugify
assert slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify('  a--b  ') == 'a-b'
assert slugify('C++ 101') == 'c-101'
assert slugify('') == 'n-a'
assert slugify('!!!') == 'n-a'
"

solution.slug.py:
import re

def slugify(text):
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text.lower()).strip('-')
    return s or 'n-a'
